prompt: We rolled out a new pricing page in 3 of our 8 international markets last quarter, while the other 5 kept the old page. I have monthly conversion data going back 2 years for all 8 markets. How should I estimate the impact of the new pricing page?
assertions: Claude recommends differences-in-differences (DiD) or describes the equivalent estimator (compare pre-post change in treated markets to pre-post change in control markets)
Claude names the parallel-trends assumption (or describes it: in the absence of treatment, the treated and control markets would have followed the same trajectory)
Claude recommends examining pre-treatment trends as a diagnostic for the parallel-trends assumption
Claude flags at least one DiD failure mode (anticipation effects, differential shocks during the post-period, composition changes, or selection of which markets got the rollout)
